arrange.align.description: Aligns the selected floating object to the left, centre or right of the page margins.

arrange.bounds.description: Moves or resizes the selected object to a width, height and top-left x, y on a page, in points.

arrange.bringForward.description: Brings the selected floating object one step forward.

arrange.group.description: Groups the selected pictures, shapes and text boxes into one object.

arrange.nudge.description: Moves the selected object by dx and dy points.

arrange.position.description: Positions the selected floating object at a preset place on the page (top left to bottom right) or at an offset.

arrange.rotate.description: Rotates the selected object 90 degrees right or left, or flips it vertically or horizontally.

arrange.rotation.description: Sets the exact clockwise rotation of the selected object in degrees, with optional flips.

arrange.selectionPane.description: Lists the document's pictures, shapes and text boxes with their Selection Pane indexes.

arrange.sendBackward.description: Sends the selected floating object one step backward.

arrange.ungroup.description: Splits the selected group back into its objects.

arrange.wrap.description: Sets how text wraps around the selected object: inline, square, tight, through, top and bottom, behind or in front of text.

artText.insert.description: Inserts decorative art text, optionally warped by a preset.

oneOf.description: a warp preset such as textArchUp, textWave1, textInflate

autoText.insert.description: Saves the selection as an AutoText entry or inserts one by name.

autocorrect.options.description: Turns AutoCorrect on or off, or adds a replacement (from, to), and answers the AutoCorrect list.

bibliography.insert.description: Inserts a bibliography of the cited sources at the caret with a title.

bookmark.insert.description: Adds a named bookmark at the selection, for edit.goto and cross-references.

caption.insert.description: Inserts a numbered caption (Figure, Table, Equation) with text at the caret or below the selected object.

caret.docEnd.description: Moves the caret to the end of the document; extend selects up to there.

caret.docStart.description: Moves the caret to the start of the document; extend selects up to there.

caret.down.description: Moves the caret to the line below; extend grows the selection; answers the new caret.

caret.end.description: Moves the caret to the end of its line; extend grows the selection.

caret.home.description: Moves the caret to the start of its line; extend grows the selection.

caret.left.description: Moves the caret one character left (back in reading order); extend grows the selection; answers the new caret.

caret.pageDown.description: Moves the caret down by `distance` points (one screen in the editor), keeping its place across the line; without `distance`, to the start of the next page's first line (on the last page, to the end). extend grows the selection.

caret.pageUp.description: Moves the caret up by `distance` points (one screen in the editor), keeping its place across the line; without `distance`, to the start of the previous page's first line (on the first page, its own). extend grows the selection.

caret.paraDown.description: Moves the caret to the start of the next paragraph; extend grows the selection.

caret.paraUp.description: Moves the caret to the start of the previous paragraph; extend grows the selection.

caret.pastCitation.description: Moves the caret past the citation it is in.

caret.right.description: Moves the caret one character right; extend grows the selection; answers the new caret.

caret.set.description: Puts the caret at a position (a document position, as file.selection answers) or at a point on a page, optionally extending the selection. With `unit` it selects the word, line, paragraph (with its mark) or paragraph's text (without it) at `pos`; with `extend` too, the selection grows by that unit from the range `start`..`end` (else the anchor), which stays selected.

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

start.description: where the range the selection grows from starts (with `unit` and `extend`)

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

end.description: where the range the selection grows from ends (with `unit` and `extend`)

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

caret.up.description: Moves the caret to the line above; extend grows the selection; answers the new caret.

caret.wordLeft.description: Moves the caret to the start of the previous word; extend grows the selection.

caret.wordRight.description: Moves the caret to the start of the next word; extend grows the selection.

change.accept.description: Accepts the tracked change at the caret or in the selection.

change.acceptAll.description: Accepts every tracked change in the document.

change.list.description: Lists the tracked changes with their kind, author, date and text.

change.markup.description: Steps how revisions display in the editor (simple, all markup, no markup, original).

change.next.description: Moves to the next tracked change and answers it.

change.options.description: Sets which revisions show in the editor (comments, ink, insertions and deletions, formatting, balloons).

change.previous.description: Moves to the previous tracked change and answers it.

change.reject.description: Rejects the tracked change at the caret or in the selection.

change.rejectAll.description: Rejects every tracked change in the document.

change.showMarkup.description: Toggles showing revision markup in the editor.

change.track.description: Turns Track Changes on or off; without value it toggles. Tracked edits are kept as revisions to accept or reject.

chart.insert.description: Inserts a chart (column, bar, line, pie…) with categories and series values at the caret.

citation.insert.description: Inserts a citation of a source (by tag, adding the source when given) at the caret, with pages.

citation.sources.description: Adds or removes a bibliography source and answers the source list.

remove.description: tag of the source to remove

citation.style.description: Sets the citation and bibliography style (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE).

comment.add.description: Starts a comment thread on the selection with text and an author.

comment.anchor.description: Answers the selection as a comment anchor for a host that keeps comment threads itself (Kit UI protocol section 7k): the paragraphs' object ids, the text range, the quoted text and the page; null for a caret.

comment.delete.description: Deletes a comment thread, or one reply in it.

comment.deleteCurrent.description: Deletes a comment by id, the comment at the caret, or all comments.

comment.edit.description: Replaces the text of a comment by its id.

comment.goto.description: Moves the caret to a comment thread's anchor.

comment.locate.description: Answers where each of a host's comment anchors is in the document now, after edits: whether it is found, the text it covers, its page, and the rectangles to highlight.

comment.new.description: Adds a comment with text on the selection (or the word at the caret).

comment.next.description: Moves to the next comment and answers it.

comment.pane.description: Lists the document's comments with their ids, authors, text and the text they are on.

comment.previous.description: Moves to the previous comment and answers it.

comment.reply.description: Adds a reply to a comment thread by its thread id.

comment.replyCurrent.description: Replies to a comment by its id.

comment.resolve.description: Marks a comment thread as resolved, or reopens it.

comment.resolveCurrent.description: Marks the comment at the caret as resolved.

comment.threads.description: Lists the comment threads with their ids, anchors (object, range, quote, page position), comments and resolved state.

crossReference.insert.description: Inserts a cross-reference to a heading, bookmark, figure or table, showing its text, number or page.

drawing.arrange.description: Moves floating drawing objects to the front, back, or one step in the stacking order.

drawing.chart.description: Changes a chart by id: kind, title, legend, data labels, gridlines, axis titles and series.

drawing.connect.description: Draws a connector between two drawing objects, straight, bent or curved.

oneOf.description: connection site index on the from shape
connection site index on the to shape

drawing.delete.description: Deletes drawing objects by their ids from drawing.describe.

drawing.describe.description: Answers drawing objects (shapes, pictures, text boxes, charts, ink, groups) with ids, geometry, frame, fill, stroke and text; default: the selected shapes, else all.

drawing.erase.description: Deletes the ink strokes a path or a circle touches.

drawing.format.description: Changes the fill, stroke or geometry of drawing objects by id.

oneOf.description: a colour: "#rrggbb" or a theme slot such as "accent1"; "none" for no fill

stroke.description: the outline: {color?, width? (pt), dash?} or {none: true}

drawing.group.description: Groups two or more floating shapes and pictures on one page into a group.

drawing.ink.description: Adds ink strokes (pen, pencil or highlighter) through points in page points.

drawing.insert.description: Inserts a floating drawing object (shape, text box or chart) with geometry, a frame in page points, placement, fill, stroke and text; answers its id.

oneOf.description: a colour: "#rrggbb" or a theme slot such as "accent1"; "none" for no fill

stroke.description: the outline: {color?, width? (pt), dash?} or {none: true}

drawing.reconnect.description: Moves one end of a connector to another object's connection site or to a point.

drawing.text.description: Replaces the text of a drawing object, as plain text or as formatted paragraphs.

drawing.transform.description: Moves, resizes, rotates or flips drawing objects by id, to a frame or by offsets.

drawing.ungroup.description: Splits groups back into their objects.

dropCap.set.description: Makes the first letter of the paragraph at the caret a drop cap over a number of lines (0 removes it).

edit.advancedFind.description: Finds every occurrence of a text in the main text, the selection or the headers and footers, and answers them all.

edit.clipboardItems.description: Lists the items on the Office clipboard, newest first.

edit.clipboardPane.description: Shows or hides the Office clipboard pane in the editor.

edit.copy.description: Copies the selection to the clipboard without changing the document.

html.description: the copy as an HTML document (empty when it has no text)

edit.copyFormat.description: Copies the selection's character and paragraph formatting.

edit.cut.description: Removes the selection and puts it on the clipboard; answers its text and HTML as edit.copy does.

edit.deleteClipboardItem.description: Removes one item (0 = newest) from the Office clipboard.

edit.find.description: Finds the next occurrence of a text (with case, whole-word or regex options) after the caret and selects it; answers where it is.

edit.findNext.description: Selects the next occurrence of the last search.

edit.findPrevious.description: Selects the previous occurrence of the last search.

edit.formatPainter.description: Picks up the selection's formatting for pasting onto other text; sticky keeps it for several pastes.

edit.goto.description: Moves the caret to a page (numbered from 1), a bookmark, or a body paragraph or table by its file.inspect index (from 0).

edit.paste.description: Pastes the clipboard (or the given text) at the caret, keeping its formatting.

edit.pasteAllClipboard.description: Pastes every item of the Office clipboard at the caret, oldest first.

edit.pasteClipboardItem.description: Pastes one item of the Office clipboard (0 = newest) at the caret.

edit.pasteFormat.description: Applies the formatting copied with edit.copyFormat to the selection.

edit.pasteMerge.description: Pastes the clipboard (or the given text) at the caret, merging its formatting with the surrounding text.

edit.pasteSpecial.description: Pastes given text, HTML or RTF (or the clipboard) at the caret in a chosen form: formatted, RTF, HTML or plain text.

edit.pasteText.description: Pastes the clipboard (or the given text) at the caret as plain text, taking the formatting at the caret.

edit.redo.description: Redoes the last undone step of the caller's own scope.

edit.repeat.description: Repeats the last editing action (F4) at the caret or selection.

edit.replace.description: Replaces the next occurrence of a text after the caret with another text.

edit.replaceAll.description: Replaces every occurrence of a text in the document (case, whole-word or regex options) and answers how many changed.

edit.selectAll.description: Selects the whole body of the document (Ctrl+A).

edit.undo.description: Undoes the last step of the caller's own scope (an agent undoes its own edits, not the person's).

endnote.insert.description: Inserts an endnote reference at the caret with the note's text; with text the caret stays after the reference, without it goes into the note (header.close returns to the reference).

equation.backspace.description: Deletes backwards in the equation at the caret.

equation.convert.description: Converts the equation (or every equation) between professional (built up) and linear form.

equation.delete.description: Deletes forwards in the equation at the caret.

equation.display.description: Makes the equation a display equation on its own line, or inline.

equation.edit.description: Puts the caret into the equation at the selection, optionally at a position inside it.

equation.enter.description: Adds a new line in the equation at the caret.

equation.exit.description: Leaves the equation, putting the caret after it (or before it).

equation.gallery.description: Lists the equation structures with their ids for equation.insertStructure.

equation.get.description: Answers the equation at the selection as linear format and LaTeX, with its structure.

equation.inputFormat.description: Sets how typed equation input is read: Unicode linear format or LaTeX.

equation.insert.description: Inserts an equation at the caret from linear format, LaTeX or a built-in equation (Pythagoras, quadratic…), and puts the caret in it.

equation.insertStructure.description: Inserts a structure (fraction, script, radical…) into the equation by gallery id, linear format or LaTeX.

equation.insertSymbol.description: Inserts a math symbol into the equation at the caret.

equation.justify.description: Sets the justification of a display equation (centred as a group, centred, left or right).

equation.move.description: Moves the caret inside the equation (left, right, up, down, home, end, next or previous slot).

equation.normalText.description: Turns normal (non-math) text entry on or off in the equation.

equation.number.description: Adds or removes a number on the display equation.

equation.set.description: Replaces the equation at the selection with linear-format or LaTeX input.

equation.structure.description: Applies an action to the structure at the equation caret (add a row, change a delimiter…), as equation.structureActions lists.

equation.structureActions.description: Lists the actions available on the structure at the equation caret, for equation.structure.

equation.type.description: Types text into the equation at the caret; linear-format input builds structures.

field.insert.description: Inserts a field code (PAGE, DATE, REF…) at the caret with an optional result text.

field.insertDateTime.description: Inserts the current date or time at the caret in a format, as fixed text or as a field that updates.

field.insertDocProperty.description: Inserts a document property (Title, Author, Subject…) as a field at the caret.

field.updateAll.description: Updates the fields in the selection (or the whole document): page numbers, dates, cross-references, tables of contents.

file.accessibility.description: Answers accessibility issues in the document (missing alt text, heading order, table headers…) with where they are.

file.close.description: Closes the document; unsaved changes are lost unless saved first.

file.combine.description: Combines another document's tracked changes and comments into this one.

file.compare.description: Compares the document with a revised version (a file or text) and marks the differences as tracked changes.

file.compatibility.description: Answers features that older Word versions cannot show.

file.encrypt.description: Sets or removes the password that Word documents are saved encrypted with.

file.export.description: Answers the document as a PDF, or one page (1-based) as a PNG image at a scale in pixels per point, as base64 for the host to write as a new file; nothing is written and the document does not change.

file.exportPdf.description: Writes the document as a PDF to a path, without changing the document or its path.

file.exportPng.description: Writes one page (1-based) as a PNG image to a path, at a scale in pixels per point.

file.info.description: Answers the document's file information: path, format, size, dates, properties, protection and page and word counts.

file.inspect.description: Answers the document's structure: pages, sections, paragraphs by index with their styles and short text, the selection and counts; with text true it includes each paragraph's full text. Use file.text for all the text.

file.layout.description: Answers a summary of the laid-out pages: page count, size and which paragraphs fall on each page.

file.new.description: Replaces the open document with a new one, blank or from a template (sample, letter, resume, report).

file.newFromTemplate.description: Creates a new document from a template file.

file.open.description: Opens a document from a path, or from base64 data named by path, with a password for encrypted files.

file.options.description: Answers the editor's options (user name, proofing, autocorrect).

file.paragraph.description: Answers one paragraph's details by its path (index from file.inspect): text, runs with formatting, style and paragraph properties.

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

file.print.description: Answers the document as the PDF the editor hands to the system print dialog.

file.properties.description: Sets document properties (title, subject, author, keywords, comments, category, custom properties) saved with the file.

file.protect.description: Marks the document as protected in a mode (read only, comments, tracked changes), or unprotects it.

file.recover.description: Answers the unsaved documents that can be recovered.

file.removeHiddenContent.description: Removes chosen kinds of hidden content (comments, revisions, properties, hidden text, headers) and answers what was found.

file.restrictEditing.description: Restricts editing to read only, comments, tracked changes or forms, or removes the restriction.

file.save.description: Saves the document to its path or a new path (docx by default; the extension picks the format), optionally encrypting it with a password.

file.saveAs.description: Saves the document under a new path, which becomes its path; optionally encrypted with a password.

file.saveTemplate.description: Saves the document as a template to a path.

file.selection.description: Answers the selection: its anchor and focus positions, the selected text and the formatting there.

file.setAuthor.description: Sets the user name recorded as the author of new tracked changes and comments.

file.setText.description: Replaces the whole body with the given plain text, one paragraph per line, in the Normal style.

file.share.description: Answers how to share the document.

file.text.description: Answers the document's whole body text as plain text, one paragraph per line; read this before editing, since inspect alone shows little content.

file.versions.description: Saves a labelled version of the document or restores an earlier one, and answers the version list.

file.wordCount.description: Answers the document's (or selection's) pages, words, characters, paragraphs and lines, optionally counting text boxes; each Chinese or Japanese character counts as a word, as in Word.

footer.edit.description: Moves the caret into the footer of the current section for editing.

footer.insert.description: Sets the footer of the current section from text or a preset layout.

footer.remove.description: Removes the footer of the current section.

footnote.insert.description: Inserts a footnote reference at the caret with the note's text; with text the caret stays after the reference, without it goes into the note (header.close returns to the reference).

footnote.next.description: Moves to the next footnote reference and answers it.

footnote.options.description: Sets footnote and endnote number formats, starting numbers and placement.

footnote.show.description: Lists the footnotes and endnotes with their numbers and text.

format.alignLeft.description: Aligns the selected paragraphs to the left.

format.alignRight.description: Aligns the selected paragraphs to the right.

format.allCaps.description: Toggles showing the selection in capital letters, without changing the letters stored.

format.bold.description: Sets bold on the selection (or the word at the caret); without value it toggles.

format.border.description: Sets a border around the selected characters; without value it toggles.

format.changeCase.description: Changes the letters of the selection to sentence, lower, upper or title case, or toggles case.

format.charStyle.description: Applies a character style to the selection.

format.clear.description: Clears all formatting from the selection, as Word's Clear All Formatting: its character formatting goes and its paragraphs become Normal (format.resetChar keeps the paragraph style).

format.color.description: Sets the text colour of the selection as RRGGBB hex, or auto.

format.decreaseFontSize.description: Steps the selection's font size down to the previous size in the size list.

format.decreaseFontSizeByOne.description: Makes the selection's font one point smaller.

format.doubleStrikethrough.description: Toggles double strikethrough on the selection.

format.doubleUnderline.description: Toggles double underline on the selection.

format.emboss.description: Toggles the emboss text effect on the selection.

format.engrave.description: Toggles the engrave text effect on the selection.

format.fontDialog.description: Answers the selection's character formatting as the Font dialog shows it.

format.fontName.description: Sets the font family of the selection.

format.fontSize.description: Sets the font size in points of the selection.

format.hidden.description: Toggles hidden text on the selection; hidden text does not show or print unless marks are shown.

format.highlight.description: Highlights the selection with a highlighter colour (yellow, brightGreen, turquoise…), or removes it with none.

format.increaseFontSize.description: Steps the selection's font size up to the next size in the size list.

format.increaseFontSizeByOne.description: Makes the selection's font one point larger.

format.italic.description: Sets italic on the selection; without value it toggles.

format.justify.description: Justifies the selected paragraphs between the margins.

format.outline.description: Toggles the outline text effect on the selection.

format.position.description: Raises or lowers the selected characters from the baseline by points.

format.resetChar.description: Removes the selection's own character formatting (or the formatting picked at the caret), keeping the paragraph's style and paragraph formatting, as Word's Ctrl+Space.

format.scale.description: Stretches or squeezes the selected characters horizontally by a percentage.

format.set.description: Sets several character properties of the selection in one call (font, size, colour, bold, italic, underline…); the general form of the format.* commands.

props.description: character properties as format.state answers them (font, size, bold, italic, color…); colours are "RRGGBB" (color also "auto")

format.shading.description: Sets the background shading of the selected characters as RRGGBB, or removes it with null.

format.shadow.description: Toggles the shadow text effect on the selection.

format.smallCaps.description: Toggles small capitals on the selection.

format.spacing.description: Expands or condenses the spacing between the selected characters by points.

format.state.description: Answers the character and paragraph formatting at the selection (font, size, bold, italic, style, alignment…), as the ribbon shows it.

format.strikethrough.description: Sets strikethrough on the selection; without value it toggles.

format.underline.description: Sets underline on the selection with a style (single, double, thick, dotted, wave, words…); without value it toggles.

format.wordUnderline.description: Toggles underlining of words only (not the spaces) on the selection.

header.close.description: Leaves the header, footer or note and returns the caret to where it was in the body (after a note's reference mark).

header.edit.description: Moves the caret into the header of the current section for editing.

header.insert.description: Sets the header of the current section from text or a preset layout.

header.remove.description: Removes the header of the current section.

headerFooter.next.description: Moves to the header or footer of the next section.

headerFooter.position.description: Sets the distance of the header and footer from the page edge in points.

headerFooter.previous.description: Moves to the header or footer of the previous section.

horizontalLine.insert.description: Inserts a horizontal line paragraph at the caret.

image.altText.description: Sets the alternative text of the selected picture.

image.border.description: Sets the border colour and width of the selected picture.

image.change.description: Replaces the selected picture's image from a path or base64 data, keeping its size and position.

data.description: the new picture's bytes in base64

image.color.description: Recolours the selected picture (grayscale, sepia, washout, black and white, saturation, tint).

image.compress.description: Downsamples the selected picture to at most a number of pixels to make the file smaller.

image.corrections.description: Adjusts the selected picture's brightness, contrast and sharpness (-100 to 100).

image.crop.description: Crops the selected picture by fractions (0 to 0.45) of its width and height from each side.

image.effects.description: Applies an artistic effect (blur, sharpen, invert, posterize, pixelate) to the selected picture.

image.insert.description: Inserts a picture from a path or base64 data at the caret, with a width in points and alternative text.

image.removeBackground.description: Removes the selected picture's background colour within a tolerance.

image.reset.description: Removes every adjustment from the selected picture.

image.size.description: Sets the selected picture's width and height in points or a scale percentage, keeping the aspect ratio when asked.

image.style.description: Applies a picture style (simple frame, thick frame, rounded, soft edge, shadow) to the selected picture.

image.transparency.description: Sets the selected picture's transparency from 0 to 100 percent.

index.insert.description: Inserts an index of the marked entries at the caret.

index.markEntry.description: Marks the selection (or a given entry text) as an index entry.

index.update.description: Rebuilds the index from the marked entries.

ink.erase.description: Deletes the ink stroke at a point on a page.

ink.eraser.description: Selects the ink eraser in the editor, or with a point deletes the ink stroke there.

ink.hide.description: Hides or shows ink in the editor.

ink.highlighter.description: Selects the highlighter ink tool in the editor with a colour and width.

ink.pen.description: Selects the pen ink tool in the editor with a colour and width.

ink.pencil.description: Selects the pencil ink tool in the editor with a colour and width.

ink.select.description: Switches the editor back to selecting objects from an ink tool.

ink.shape.description: Selects a shape preset to draw next in the editor, or none.

ink.state.description: Answers the editor's current ink tool, colour and width.

ink.stroke.description: Draws one ink stroke through points on a page (page points, at most 5000) with a tool, colour and width.

link.insert.description: Turns the selection into a hyperlink to a URL, or inserts linked text at the caret.

link.remove.description: Removes the hyperlink at the caret or selection, keeping its text.

list.define.description: Defines a new multilevel list (number format, text, start, indents per level) and applies it to the selected paragraphs; a number format it can't draw is refused.

num.description: list id to change in place (default: a new list)

list.get.description: Answers a list's definition (each level's format, text and indents); default: the list at the caret.

macro.list.description: Runs, defines or deletes a macro (a named list of command steps) and answers the macro list.

macro.record.description: Starts recording commands into a named macro; calling it again stops and saves the recording.

mailMerge.addressBlock.description: Inserts an address block merge field at the caret.

mailMerge.checkErrors.description: Checks the merge for missing fields or recipients and answers the problems.

mailMerge.editRecipients.description: Replaces the mail merge recipient rows or fields.

mailMerge.envelopes.description: Turns the document into an envelope with a delivery and a return address and a size.

mailMerge.findRecipient.description: Moves the merge preview to a recipient.

mailMerge.finish.description: Merges the document with every recipient (or a range of records) into one merged document, optionally saved to a path.

mailMerge.greetingLine.description: Inserts a greeting line merge field at the caret.

mailMerge.highlightFields.description: Toggles highlighting of merge fields in the editor.

mailMerge.insertField.description: Inserts a merge field for a recipient field at the caret.

mailMerge.labels.description: Turns the document into a sheet of labels with text or the recipients, in rows and columns.

mailMerge.matchFields.description: Answers how the document's merge fields match the recipient fields.

mailMerge.next.description: Shows the next recipient's data in the merge preview.

mailMerge.preview.description: Toggles previewing the merge results with a recipient's data in place of the fields.

mailMerge.previous.description: Shows the previous recipient's data in the merge preview.

mailMerge.recipients.description: Sets the mail merge recipients from CSV text, a file, or rows, with their field names.

mailMerge.rules.description: Inserts a merge rule field (IF, SKIPIF, NEXT, MERGEREC) at the caret.

mailMerge.start.description: Starts a mail merge of a kind (letters, emails, envelopes, labels, directory) or turns it off with normal.

object.insert.description: Inserts the contents of a file as an object at the caret.

page.borders.description: Puts a border around every page (box with width, colour and line style), or removes it.

page.break.description: Inserts a page, column or text-wrapping break, or a section break (next page, continuous, even or odd page), at the caret.

page.color.description: Sets the page background colour as RRGGBB, or removes it with null.

page.columns.description: Sets the number of text columns (1 to 12) of the current section, with spacing, a separator line or set widths.

page.differentFirstPage.description: Toggles a different header and footer on the first page of the current section.

page.differentOddEven.description: Toggles different headers and footers on odd and even pages.

page.hyphenation.description: Toggles automatic hyphenation for the document.

page.insertBlank.description: Inserts an empty page at the caret.

page.insertBreak.description: Inserts a page break at the caret so the following text starts on a new page.

page.insertCover.description: Inserts a one-page cover at the start of the document with a title, subtitle, author and, when given, a date (no date otherwise); title, subtitle and author default to the document's Title, Subject and Author properties. The caret stays where it was.

page.lineNumbers.description: Turns line numbers in the margin off, continuous, or restarting each page or section.

page.linkToPrevious.description: Toggles linking the current section's header (or footer) to the previous section's.

page.margins.description: Sets the page margins of the current section from a preset or in points per side.

page.orientation.description: Sets the current section's page orientation to portrait or landscape.

page.pageNumberFormat.description: Sets the page number format (1, i, I, a, A) and starting number of the current section.

page.pageSetup.description: Changes the current section's page setup in one call: only the fields given (size, orientation, margins, columns, vertical alignment…) change, the others keep their values.

section.description: the section fields to change, named as page.section answers them (pageW, marginLeft, valign…); fields not given are kept, unknown ones are refused

page.section.description: Answers the current section's page properties: size, orientation, margins, columns and header settings.

page.size.description: Sets the current section's paper size: by name (Letter, A4…), keeping the orientation, or as a width and height in points, kept as given (wider than tall is landscape).

page.verticalAlign.description: Sets the current section's vertical alignment of text on its pages: top, center or bottom.

page.watermark.description: Adds a text watermark (diagonal or horizontal, with colour) behind every page, or removes it.

pageNumber.insert.description: Inserts a page number field at the top or bottom of the page or at the caret, aligned left, centre or right (at the caret: the caret's paragraph, when align is given), optionally as Page x of y.

paragraph.addSpaceBefore.description: Adds 12 points of space before the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.align.description: Sets the alignment of the selected paragraphs by name, as seen on the page (left, center, right, justify, distribute) or in reading order (start, end).

paragraph.asianTypography.description: Sets East Asian typography options of the selected paragraphs: line-breaking rules, word wrap and punctuation compression.

paragraph.borders.description: Applies a paragraph border (bottom, top, box, inside, none…) to the selected paragraphs, with width and colour.

paragraph.bullets.description: Makes the selected paragraphs a bulleted list (with a bullet kind or character), or removes the bullets with off.

paragraph.defineBullet.description: Defines a bullet character and applies it to the selected list paragraphs.

paragraph.defineNumber.description: Defines a number format (decimal, Roman, letters), number text and start, and applies it to the selected list.

paragraph.dialog.description: Answers a paragraph's formatting as the Paragraph dialog shows it: the caret's paragraph, or the one at path. props is in the form paragraph.set takes; direct holds only the paragraph's own settings.

paragraph.distribute.description: Distributes the characters of the selected paragraphs evenly across the line.

paragraph.double.description: Sets double line spacing on the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.hangingIndent.description: Adds a hanging indent to the selected paragraphs, or increases it.

paragraph.heading1.description: Applies the Heading 1 style to the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.heading2.description: Applies the Heading 2 style to the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.heading3.description: Applies the Heading 3 style to the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.indent.description: Increases the left indent of the selected paragraphs by one step.

paragraph.indents.description: Sets the left, right and first-line indents of the selected paragraphs in points (a negative first line is hanging).

paragraph.insert.description: Inserts a new paragraph with text after or before the paragraph at an index (as file.inspect numbers them), keeping the neighbouring style.

paragraph.keepLines.description: Toggles keeping all lines of the selected paragraphs on one page.

paragraph.keepNext.description: Toggles keep-with-next on the selected paragraphs so they stay on the page with the following one.

paragraph.lineSpacing.description: Sets the line spacing of the selected paragraphs as a multiple, as at least some points, or as exactly some points.

paragraph.listLevel.description: Sets the list level (0 to 8) of the selected list paragraphs.

paragraph.ltr.description: Makes the selected paragraphs left to right (true) or right to left (false).

paragraph.multilevel.description: Applies a multilevel list (legal or outline numbering) to the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.normal.description: Applies the Normal style to the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.numbering.description: Makes the selected paragraphs a numbered list in a format (1., 1), A., a., i., outline), or removes numbering with off.

paragraph.oneAndHalf.description: Sets 1.5 line spacing on the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.outdent.description: Decreases the left indent of the selected paragraphs by one step.

paragraph.outlineLevel.description: Steps the outline level of the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.pageBreakBefore.description: Toggles a page break before the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.removeHanging.description: Reduces the hanging indent of the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.removeSpaceAfter.description: Removes the space after the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.restartNumbering.description: Restarts the numbering of the list at the caret from 1.

paragraph.rtl.description: Makes the selected paragraphs right to left (true) or left to right (false).

paragraph.set.description: Sets several paragraph properties of the selected paragraphs in one call (alignment, indents, spacing, line spacing, keep options…).

props.description: paragraph properties as paragraph.dialog answers them (alignment, indents, spacing…); colours (shading, border colors) are "RRGGBB"

paragraph.setNumberingValue.description: Sets the number of the list item at the caret, renumbering the items after it.

paragraph.shading.description: Sets the background shading of the selected paragraphs as RRGGBB, or removes it with null.

paragraph.single.description: Sets single line spacing on the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.sort.description: Sorts the selected paragraphs alphabetically, ascending or descending.

paragraph.spacing.description: Sets the space before and after the selected paragraphs in points.

paragraph.style.description: Applies a paragraph style (by name or id, such as Heading 1 or Quote) to the selected paragraphs; style.list names them.

paragraph.tabs.description: Replaces, sets or clears tab stops (position, alignment, leader) of the selected paragraphs.

paragraph.text.description: Replaces the text of the paragraph at an index, keeping its style and paragraph formatting.

paragraph.widowControl.description: Toggles widow and orphan control on the selected paragraphs.

presence.caret.description: Answers the caret and selection as object-model positions (object, field, offset), for showing it to collaborators.

presence.locate.description: Answers page positions for given object-model caret positions, for drawing collaborators' carets.

quickPart.insert.description: Saves the selection as a named building block, inserts one, or deletes one, and answers the list.

readAloud.next.description: Moves reading aloud to the next sentence.

readAloud.open.description: Starts reading the document aloud from the caret, optionally skipping citations.

readAloud.previous.description: Moves reading aloud to the previous sentence.

readAloud.skipCitations.description: Sets whether reading aloud skips citations and the bibliography.

readAloud.speed.description: Sets the reading-aloud speed from 0.5 to 3 (1 is normal).

readAloud.status.description: Answers whether reading aloud is running, its speed and the sentence it is on.

research.open.description: Opens the Researcher pane in the editor.

select.addObject.description: Adds an object (by position or Selection Pane index) to the object selection.

pos.description: a position as file.selection answers (or {"block", "off"?} in the body)

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

select.collapse.description: Collapses the selection to the caret.

select.column.description: Makes a rectangular (column) selection between two positions or two page points, as Alt+drag does.

select.extend.description: Turns on extend mode in the editor, so caret moves grow the selection.

select.line.description: Selects the line the caret is on.

select.objects.description: Selects an object by its Selection Pane index, or every object.

select.paragraph.description: Selects the paragraph at the caret.

select.range.description: Selects from an anchor position to a focus position (positions as file.selection answers).

select.sentence.description: Selects the sentence at the caret.

select.similar.description: Selects all text with the same formatting as the selection.

select.text.description: Finds a text in the document and selects its first (or nth) occurrence; the usual way to target words before formatting them.

select.word.description: Selects the word at the caret.

shape.change.description: Changes the selected shape to another preset kind, keeping its size and text.

shape.effects.description: Sets shadow, glow, soft edge and reflection effects on the selected shape.

oneOf.description: true: the default shadow, false: none

shape.fill.description: Sets the selected shape's fill colour as RRGGBB, or removes the fill with null.

shape.insert.description: Inserts a floating shape (rectangle, ellipse, triangle, arrow, star…) at the caret with a size, fill and text.

shape.outline.description: Sets the selected shape's outline colour and width, or removes it with null.

signatureLine.insert.description: Inserts a signature line with the signer's name and title at the caret.

spelling.addToDictionary.description: Adds a word (default: the word at the caret) to the dictionary so it is no longer flagged.

spelling.applySuggestion.description: Replaces the flagged word at the caret with a suggestion text.

spelling.check.description: Answers the first spelling or grammar issue from the caret onward, with suggestions; changes nothing.

spelling.editor.description: Answers the Editor pane's summary of spelling, grammar and refinement issues.

spelling.ignoreAll.description: Ignores every occurrence of the flagged word at the caret in this document.

spelling.issues.description: Lists every spelling and grammar issue in the document with its position and suggestions.

spelling.language.description: Sets the proofing language of the selection, or marks it not to be proofed.

spelling.proofing.description: Toggles checking spelling as you type in the editor.

spelling.suggestions.description: Answers spelling suggestions for the word at the caret or at a position.

oneOf.description: no spelling or grammar issue there

pos.description: a position as file.selection answers (or {"block", "off"?} in the body)

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

spelling.thesaurus.description: Answers synonyms for the word at the caret.

spreadsheet.insert.description: Inserts a table from CSV text at the caret.

style.add.description: Creates a new paragraph style, based on another style or on the selection's formatting.

style.addToGallery.description: Adds the selection's style to the Styles gallery.

style.apply.description: Opens the Apply Styles box in the editor, or applies a style by name when given.

style.delete.description: Deletes a custom style; paragraphs that used it fall back to its base style.

style.inspect.description: Answers the formatting layers at the selection: paragraph style, direct paragraph formatting, character style and direct character formatting.

style.inspector.description: Shows or hides the Style Inspector pane in the editor.

style.inspectorClear.description: Clears one formatting layer at the selection (paragraph style, paragraph formatting, character style or character formatting).

style.list.description: Lists the styles shown in the Styles gallery with their names and ids.

style.manage.description: Lists the document's styles with their id, name, type and whether they show in the gallery, sorted as recommended or alphabetically.

style.pane.description: Shows or hides the Styles pane in the editor.

style.set.description: Changes a style's character or paragraph properties, its name or its next style; every paragraph using it changes.

chr.description: character properties as format.state answers them (font, size, bold, italic, color…); colours are "RRGGBB" (color also "auto")

para.description: paragraph properties as paragraph.dialog answers them (alignment, indents, spacing…); colours (shading, border colors) are "RRGGBB"

style.setVisibility.description: Shows or hides a style in the Styles gallery and the style lists.

style.updateToMatch.description: Updates a style (default: the selection's) to match the selection's formatting.

symbol.insert.description: Inserts a character at the caret, optionally in its own symbol font.

table.autofit.description: Autofits the table at the caret to its contents, to the window, or fixes its column widths.

table.borderPainter.description: Toggles the border painter tool in the editor.

table.borders.description: Applies borders (all, outside, inside, none, a single side) to the selected cells' edges, with width and colour; with the whole table selected, or only a caret in it, to the table.

table.cellAlign.description: Sets the text alignment inside the selected table cells (top left to bottom right).

table.cellMargins.description: Sets the default cell margins of the table at the caret in points.

table.columnWidth.description: Sets the width in points of the caret cell's column.

table.deleteCells.description: Deletes the selected cells of the table, shifting the others.

table.deleteColumn.description: Deletes the selected columns of the table at the caret.

table.deleteRow.description: Deletes the selected rows of the table at the caret.

table.deleteStyle.description: Deletes a custom table style; default: the current table's style.

table.deleteTable.description: Deletes the whole table at the caret.

table.distributeColumns.description: Gives the selected table columns equal widths.

table.distributeRows.description: Gives the selected table rows equal heights.

table.draw.description: Draws a table or a cell border as a pen stroke between two points on a page.

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

table.eraser.description: Removes the border between two cells within 4 points of a point on a page, merging them.

table.formula.description: Inserts a formula field into the table cell at the caret and answers its result: arithmetic (+ - * / ^ %, comparisons), cell references and ranges (B2, B2:C4, B:B, 3:3), ABOVE, BELOW, LEFT and RIGHT, the functions SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MAX, MIN, PRODUCT, ABS, INT, MOD, ROUND, SIGN, IF, AND, OR and NOT, and a \# number picture (=SUM(ABOVE) \# "£#,##0.00"). Cells read as numbers allow currency signs and thousands separators (£1,360.50). Update Field (F9) computes it again.

table.fromText.description: Converts the selected text, separated by tabs or commas, into a table.

table.insert.description: Inserts a table with the given rows and columns at the caret, optionally with a table style; the caret moves into its first cell.

table.insertColumnLeft.description: Inserts a column to the left of the caret's column in its table.

table.insertColumnRight.description: Inserts a column to the right of the caret's column in its table.

table.insertRowAbove.description: Inserts a row above the row at the caret in its table.

table.insertRowBelow.description: Inserts a row below the row at the caret in its table.

table.look.description: Turns the table style options of the table at the caret on or off: header row, total row, banded rows and columns, first and last column.

table.merge.description: Merges the selected table cells into one cell.

table.newStyle.description: Creates a table style with formatting for the whole table and its regions (header row, last row, banded rows…).

borders.description: true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit

para.description: paragraph properties as paragraph.dialog answers them (alignment, indents, spacing…); colours (shading, border colors) are "RRGGBB"; as in Word, a paragraph style that sets a property itself (Normal included) wins over the table style's

borders.description: true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit

table.properties.description: Sets the properties of the table at the caret: alignment, width, indent, row and cell options.

cellWidth.description: the caret cell's preferred width in points; null clears it (automatic)

oneOf.description: the caret cell's preferred width in points

rowHeight.description: the row height in points; null clears it (automatic)

width.description: the table's preferred width in points; null clears it (automatic)

oneOf.description: the table's preferred width in points

table.quick.description: Inserts a ready-made table (calendar, tabular list or matrix) at the caret.

table.repeatHeader.description: Toggles repeating the selected header rows at the top of every page the table runs onto.

table.rowHeight.description: Sets the height in points of the selected rows (every row when the table is selected; else the caret's), as at least or exactly that height.

table.selectCell.description: Selects the cell at the caret.

table.selectRow.description: Selects the row at the caret.

table.selectTable.description: Selects the whole table at the caret.

table.setStyle.description: Changes a table style's name, base style or region formatting; default: the current table's style.

borders.description: true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit
true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit

para.description: paragraph properties as paragraph.dialog answers them (alignment, indents, spacing…)

borders.description: true: single lines, false: none, null: inherit

table.shading.description: Sets the shading of the selected table cells as RRGGBB, or removes it.

table.sort.description: Sorts the rows of the table at the caret by a column (0-based), ascending or descending, optionally keeping a header row.

table.split.description: Splits the table cell at the caret into a number of columns.

table.splitTable.description: Splits the table into two tables above the caret's row.

table.style.description: Applies a table style to the table at the caret.

table.textDirection.description: Sets the text direction of the selected table cells (horizontal, rotated down or up).

table.toText.description: Converts the table at the caret to text with tabs, commas or paragraphs between cells.

table.viewGridlines.description: Shows or hides gridlines for table cells without borders in the editor.

tableOfAuthorities.insert.description: Inserts a table of authorities from the marked citations at the caret.

tableOfAuthorities.markCitation.description: Marks the selection (or a given text) as a citation for the table of authorities.

tableOfFigures.insert.description: Inserts a table of figures (or tables, or equations) built from captions at the caret.

tableOfFigures.update.description: Rebuilds the table of figures from the current captions.

text.backTab.description: Shift+Tab at the caret: promotes a list item one level, or moves to the previous table cell.

text.backspace.description: Deletes the selection, or the character before the caret (Backspace).

text.columnBreak.description: Inserts a column break at the caret so the following text starts in the next column.

text.delete.description: Deletes the selection, or the character after the caret (Delete).

text.deleteWordBack.description: Deletes from the caret back to the start of the previous word.

text.deleteWordForward.description: Deletes from the caret to the start of the next word.

text.insert.description: Types text at the caret, replacing the selection, with the formatting at the caret; use paragraph.insert or paragraph.text to write whole paragraphs by index.

text.insertFromFile.description: Inserts the text of a file at the caret.

text.lineBreak.description: Inserts a line break (Shift+Enter) at the caret, staying in the same paragraph.

text.move.description: Moves the selected text to `to` in one step (dragging it), or with `copy` puts a copy there; the text is selected where it lands. Refused when nothing is selected, when `to` is inside the selection or in another story, or when the selection crosses a table's edge.

to.description: where the text goes, a position as file.selection answers

story.description: "body", or {"part": n} for a header, footer, note, comment or text box story

part.description: header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment or text box story number

text.nbHyphen.description: Inserts a nonbreaking hyphen at the caret, which a line never breaks at.

text.nbsp.description: Inserts a nonbreaking space at the caret, which keeps the words on each side on one line.

text.newParagraph.description: Splits the paragraph at the caret into two (Enter); the new paragraph takes the style's next style.

text.optionalHyphen.description: Inserts an optional hyphen at the caret, shown only where the line breaks at it.

text.pageBreak.description: Inserts a page break at the caret so the following text starts on a new page.

text.tab.description: Inserts a tab at the caret; in a list item it demotes the item one level, in a table it moves to the next cell.

textBox.insert.description: Inserts a floating text box at the caret with text and a size.

theme.colors.description: Steps the theme's colour palette to the next one.

theme.effects.description: Steps the theme's effects to the next preset.

theme.fonts.description: Sets the theme's heading and body fonts.

theme.paragraphSpacing.description: Applies a document-wide paragraph spacing preset (none, compact, tight, open, relaxed, double).

theme.set.description: Applies a document theme by name, changing theme colours and fonts.

theme.setDefault.description: Makes the current theme and style set the default for new documents.

theme.styleSet.description: Applies a style set (basic, lines, shaded, casual, centered, minimalist, title) that restyles headings and body text.

toc.addText.description: Sets the table-of-contents level of the paragraphs at the selection (0 keeps them out).

toc.insert.description: Inserts a table of contents at the caret built from headings down to a level, with a title.

toc.update.description: Rebuilds the table of contents from the current headings and page numbers.

view.commentsPane.description: Shows or hides the Comments pane in the editor.

view.darkMode.description: Switches the editor between dark and light page colours.

view.draft.description: Switches the editor to Draft view.

view.focus.description: Switches the editor to Focus mode, hiding the ribbon.

view.gridlines.description: Shows or hides the page gridlines in the editor.

view.immersive.description: Switches the editor to focused reading: Read Mode with Focus.

view.marks.description: Shows or hides formatting marks (paragraph marks, spaces, tabs) in the editor.

view.multiplePages.description: Zooms the editor to show several pages side by side.

view.navigationPane.description: Shows or hides the Navigation pane (headings) in the editor.

view.newWindow.description: Opens a second editor window on the same document.

view.onePage.description: Zooms the editor to show one whole page.

view.outline.description: Switches the editor to Outline view, showing headings by level.

view.pageWidth.description: Zooms the editor to the page width.

view.printLayout.description: Switches the editor to Print Layout, showing pages as they print.

view.readMode.description: Switches the editor to Read Mode.

view.ruler.description: Shows or hides the ruler in the editor.

view.sideToSide.description: Sets page movement in the editor to side-to-side.

view.split.description: Splits the editor window into two panes on the same document, or removes the split.

view.state.description: Answers the editor's view settings: view mode, zoom, panes, marks, ruler and gridlines.

view.stylesPane.description: Shows or hides the Styles pane in the editor.

view.vertical.description: Sets page movement in the editor to vertical scrolling.

view.webLayout.description: Switches the editor to Web Layout, without page breaks.

view.zoom.description: Sets the editor zoom to a percentage (10 to 500) or to page width, one page or multiple pages.

view.zoomIn.description: Zooms the editor in one step.

view.zoomOut.description: Zooms the editor out one step.
